主要内容: Robb Report, the leading global luxury lifestyle brand, will be an official media partner for the 2016 North American International Auto Show (NAIAS). As part of the partnership, Robb Report's editorial team will broadcast live from their studio exhibit on the show floor, featuring interviews with top industry talent and cultural icons. Paul Sabatini, 2016 NAIAS Chairman, stated that Robb Report will spotlight Detroit's cultural dynamism through content creation. Stephen Colvin, CEO of Robb Report, emphasized the partnership's uniqueness in providing a 360-degree view of the automotive industry. Robb Report will also partner with NAIAS and EyesOn Design to host a cocktail event for the EyesOn Design Awards winners and will co-host The Gallery, an ultra-luxury automotive event at the MGM Grand Detroit. The collaboration includes a curated selection of luxury auction items from hospitality, culinary, style, and design sectors. The partnership marks Robb Report's inaugural collaboration with NAIAS, celebrating its 40th anniversary in 2016.
